summary: IsoEnergy Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a November 5, 2026 news release reporting assay results from the completed 2026 summer exploration drilling program at its Larocque East project in the eastern Athabasca Basin, which hosts the Hurricane deposit. The filing is operational/exploration disclosure, not a special-situation transaction: high-grade uranium intersections were confirmed in 18 of 26 holes across 550 m of strike along the Hurricane South Trend, including 15.4% U3O8 over 0.5 m roughly 500 m east of the deposit. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or transactional mechanics are present; watch exploration follow-up and resource implications, not risk-arb.
